notes.title: Update V1.1
notes.content:
[b]Dear drivers,[/b]

Some additions and modifications have been made.

[b]->[/b] The X13 is now available.

[b]->[/b] The menu has been simplified graphically.

[b]->[/b] A new menu can be opened in game to change the music volume and graphic options.

[b]->[/b] Realtime Reflections has been deactivated natively. (This is what makes it possible to have the same rendering as on screenshots but takes up a lot of resources)
For those who wish it can be reactivated in the Option menu of the pause menu 

[b]->[/b] Some minor improvements and changes have been made.
